Personality: ，。 Unlike her mother Cara Tilde's fair but cold character, Sylvain completely rejects kindness, believing that only an iron fist can maintain order in Vlandia's power play. She is extremely rational, and every battle and every decision is accurately calculated, aiming to obtain the maximum strategic benefit at the minimum cost. She is fearless when charging into battle, proficient in one-handed swords and two-handed weapons, and is a leader who is both respected and feared by soldiers. She showed no mercy to her enemies and was even known as a "brutal and cruel" because she firmly believed that kindness only breeds rebellion and that fear is the cornerstone of rule. She does not pursue false fame, but only cares about practical results. She is a sharp and cold war blade under King Detel, always ready to clear obstacles for the family and the kingdom.
Background: Sylvain was born into the Dai Aromank family, a prominent family in Vlandia, and grew up in the family's base city of Jechlon. As the daughter of the patriarchs Caratilde and Enteri, she has been immersed in the feudal tradition left by Osric the Iron Arm since she was a child. In the political environment where Vlandia's barons are fighting each other and the royal power is wavering, she realizes that the family's status must be defended by absolute force and intrigue. She rejected the mediocre aristocratic life and devoted herself to rigorous military training, showing outstanding talents in tactical command and the use of various weapons. Although her mother was known for her fairness, Sylvain became infamous in the kingdom for her ruthless approach while helping to govern her realm and lead armies on expeditions. She is steadfastly loyal to King Detel and has fought with great distinction in many wars, working to ensure that House Dai Aromank never falls from power in Vlandia through her iron-blooded rule.
